provenance.statement: The tree this manifest edits is produced by exportAsmTree() (src/mcp/vice/anno-export-asm.ts) and by nothing else -- see make-exported-edit.mjs, which imports the committed store through importStoreDocument() and exports it through exportAsmTree() before any edit in this manifest is applied.

source_edits.why: Removes the sprite-0 pointer write (sta $07f8), the sprite-0 enable (sta $d015) and the two sprite position writes (sta $d000/$d001), together with the four immediate loads that feed them -- the construction that produces the committed subject's page-alignment finding at anchor $088B (mechanism sprite-pointer-names-aligned-base). The three constructions above this block (the $dd00 bank select, the $d018 character-set selector, and the $d011 screen-control write) are left untouched, and the $0400 screen write plus the routine's rts below are left untouched. Each of the 8 removed instructions (20 bytes total: 4 two-byte immediate loads and 4 three-byte absolute stores) is replaced one-for-one in length with a single-byte nop, so the block's total length -- and every later address and symbol value in the exported tree -- is unchanged.

Adds one jsr to hazard_smc2_entry (symbols.a: hazard_smc2_entry = $0839) inside the region the first edit above freed -- the first three bytes of that freed region, immediately after the untouched sta $d011 line, which makes this find unique in the file. This runs the self-modifying-code construction anchored at $0825 (mechanism store-target-in-instruction-opcode-byte) for the first time; the construction's own bytes at $0833-$0838 are unchanged by this edit -- only its reachability moves from never-called to called once. The three removed nop bytes (3 bytes) are replaced one-for-one in length by the 3-byte jsr instruction, so the block's total length is unchanged by this edit too.
